# Quickstart and verification record

**English** · [简体中文](QUICKSTART.zh-CN.md)

[Repository home](../README.md#contents)

Use Bash on Linux or in a WSL2 Linux distribution. Run repository commands from a local checkout containing `Makefile` and `examples/`. On Windows, use PowerShell for `wsl -l -v`, then open the Linux distribution and keep the working directory on its Linux filesystem. [Linux and WSL2 setup](ENVIRONMENT.md#setup)

If you need a checkout, use the following commands with Git and GNU Make available in your Linux shell.
blocks.zh:
# 快速入门与验证记录

[English](QUICKSTART.md) · **简体中文**

[仓库首页](../README.zh-CN.md#contents)

在 Linux 或 WSL2 的 Linux 发行版中使用 Bash。仓库命令从包含 `Makefile` 和 `examples/` 的本地仓库根目录运行。在 Windows 中先用 PowerShell 运行 `wsl -l -v` 检查发行版，再进入 Linux，工作目录放在其 Linux 文件系统中。[Linux 与 WSL2 环境](ENVIRONMENT.zh-CN.md#setup)

若尚未下载仓库，先确认 Linux shell 中有 Git 与 GNU Make，再运行以下命令。

blocks.en: | What you have | Start here | | --- | --- | | A receptor and ligand, or no prepared files yet | [Dock only](#dock) | | A reviewed docked pose or a prepared MD system | [Run MD from an existing pose](#existing-pose) | | A trajectory, or precomputed series and structures | [Analyze or make figures](#existing-trajectory) | ## Dock and check a public co-crystal Install once, then run the public 1IEP CPU example. The split `docktools` environment below installs the pinned docking tools for steps 01–05. If you already have the complete `docking-gromacs` environment, activate it and run the three commands after activation.
blocks.zh: | 已有材料 | 入门路线 | | --- | --- | | 已有受体和配体，或尚无制备好的输入 | [只做对接](#dock) | | 已核验的对接位姿，或已建系的 MD 输入 | [从已有位姿开始 MD](#existing-pose) | | 已有轨迹，或已算好的指标和结构 | [分析或出图](#existing-trajectory) | ## 对接并核验公开共晶结构 初次安装后即可运行公开 1IEP CPU 示例。下方的独立 `docktools` 环境安装步骤 01–05 所需的固定版本工具。若已有完整的 `docking-gromacs` 环境，激活该环境后执行下面激活命令之后的三条命令。

blocks.shared:
```bash
conda create -n docktools --override-channels -c conda-forge python=3.11 vina=1.2.7 \
  meeko=0.8.0 rdkit=2026.03.1 gemmi=0.7.5 openbabel=3.2.1
conda activate docktools
make fixtures
make dock RUN=runs/1iep-dock THREADS=4
bash scripts/check_05.sh runs/1iep-dock
```

blocks.en:
`RUN` chooses a new isolated directory. `THREADS` is the requested per-job CPU thread allocation. The docking profile uses Vina `--exhaustiveness 8` for a short reference search, `--num_modes 5` to cap output, and `--seed 202601` by default to record the sampling seed. Vina may emit fewer than five modes. For a sensitivity check, compare exhaustiveness 8, 16, and 32 and several recorded seeds with all other inputs fixed.

In `runs/1iep-dock/`, expected files include `dock/docked.pdbqt`, `dock/lig_pose.sdf`, `dock/redocking.csv`, and `logs/vina.log`. The pinned 1IEP ligand is **+1**, which the chemistry checks enforce. The result below was observed with Vina 1.2.7, Meeko 0.8.0, Open Babel 3.2.1, four allocated CPU threads and seed 202601.
blocks.zh:
`RUN` 指定新的独立目录。`THREADS` 是单个作业申请的 CPU 线程数。对接档以 Vina 的 `--exhaustiveness 8` 做短程参考搜索，`--num_modes 5` 限定输出上限，默认 `--seed 202601` 以记录采样种子。实际可能少于五个模式。做灵敏度检查时，可在固定其他输入的前提下比较 8、16 和 32 及多个已记录的种子。

预期输出包括 `dock/docked.pdbqt`、`dock/lig_pose.sdf`、`dock/redocking.csv` 和 `logs/vina.log`。固定的 1IEP 配体带 **+1** 的 formal charge（形式电荷），化学检查严格核对。下列结果来自 Vina 1.2.7、Meeko 0.8.0、Open Babel 3.2.1，使用四个 CPU 线程，种子为 202601。

blocks.shared:
```text
PASS stage 04
Selected SDF record 1 of 3; identity and formal charge +1 match.
Top-1 RMSD 0.350 Å; best sampled RMSD 0.350 Å.
PASS stage 05
```

blocks.en:
The top Vina score was −13.270 kcal/mol. This is a docking score. RMSD compares symmetry-equivalent heavy-atom matches to the archived ligand instance in the original receptor frame, without separately fitting the ligands and without aligning the receptor a second time. The three poses gave 0.350, 12.304, and 12.192 Å. The CI check requires at least one sampled pose at or under 2 Å. Exact floating-point results may vary with the executable and platform.

[Input provenance](../examples/1iep/PROVENANCE.md) · [Three crystal references](../examples/regression/PROVENANCE.md) · [Regression RMSD script](../scripts/redocking_rmsd.py)

For your own inputs, follow [receptor and ligand preparation](DOCKING.md#local-inputs) and the [CPU, CUDA or OpenCL docking steps](DOCKING.md#batch-docking). Use a search box defined for the receptor in Å. Keep the source SDF and raw PDBQT together with the log and selected pose record. If the fixture fails, start with the first error under `runs/1iep-dock/logs/` and the [docking error index](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#docking-errors).
blocks.zh:
Vina 第一名得分为 −13.270 kcal/mol，报告为对接分数。RMSD 使用对称等效的 heavy atom（重原子）匹配，在原 receptor（受体）坐标系下与归档的配体实例比较。无配体独立叠合，也无需再次叠合 receptor（受体）。三条 docking pose（对接位姿）的结果为 0.350、12.304、12.192 Å。CI 检查要求至少采到一条 ≤2 Å 的 docking pose（对接位姿）。浮点值会随程序和平台有所差异。

[输入来源](../examples/1iep/PROVENANCE.md) · [三个共晶参考](../examples/regression/PROVENANCE.md) · [回归 RMSD 脚本](../scripts/redocking_rmsd.py)

使用自己的输入时，从[受体和配体制备](DOCKING.zh-CN.md#local-inputs)接到 [CPU、CUDA 或 OpenCL 对接](DOCKING.zh-CN.md#batch-docking)。搜索盒的位置和边长须与该 receptor（受体）坐标系对应，单位为 Å。保留原始 SDF、原始 PDBQT、日志和位姿记录。公开示例失败时，先查 `runs/1iep-dock/logs/` 中的第一条报错，再看[对接排错](TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md#docking-errors)。

blocks.en: ## Run MD from an existing docking pose Use Linux or WSL2 Bash. From a repository checkout, create or activate the full CPU environment if you need AmberTools, ACPYPE, RDKit and GROMACS together. If you use the [separate environments](ENVIRONMENT.md#setup), follow the activation commands for each stage. Bring the reviewed MD-ready protein PDB and a single-record pose SDF with verified bond orders, stereochemistry, integer charge and docked heavy-atom coordinates in the **same receptor frame**. For a PDBQT-only pose, first recover the SDF using [step 05](DOCKING.md#pose-handoff). Preserve the source ligand chemistry and atom map. Use a separate directory for each force field, pose and replicate. Replace the illustrative source paths below before running.
blocks.zh: ## 从已有 docking pose（对接位姿）开始 MD 使用 Linux 或 WSL2 Bash。若需要同时使用 AmberTools、ACPYPE、RDKit 与 GROMACS，从仓库根目录创建或激活完整的 CPU 环境。使用[拆分环境](ENVIRONMENT.zh-CN.md#setup)时，按各阶段命令切换。 准备已审查、可用于 MD 的蛋白 PDB，以及单记录位姿 SDF。核对 SDF 的键级、手性、整数净电荷和对接重原子坐标，确认两者处于**同一 receptor（受体）坐标系**。若只有 PDBQT 位姿，先按[步骤 05](DOCKING.zh-CN.md#pose-handoff)恢复 SDF。保留原始配体化学结构和原子映射。每个 force field（力场）、位姿和重复使用独立目录，执行前替换下方示例源路径。

blocks.shared:
```bash
conda env create -f environment.yml
conda activate docking-gromacs
```

```bash
protein='/path/to/reviewed_protein.pdb'
pose='/path/to/verified_pose.sdf'
run='runs/study01/amber_pose01_rep01'

test -s "$protein" && test -s "$pose" &&
  mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$run")" && mkdir -- "$run" &&
  cp -- "$protein" "$run/protein.pdb" &&
  cp -- "$pose" "$run/lig_pose.sdf" &&
  cd -- "$run"
```

blocks.en: | Entry | Handoff | | --- | --- | | Reviewed pose SDF + protein PDB | [Parameterize](SYSTEM_SETUP.md#topology) with AMBER or CHARMM. Keep the net ligand charge in units of e and verify Å-to-nm conversions. [Assemble](SYSTEM_SETUP.md#complex-assembly) to obtain `complex_raw.gro` and `topol.top` plus its includes. | | Matching assembled system and topology | Start at the applicable commands in [system preparation and equilibration](SIMULATION.md#equilibration) using the [stage MDPs](SYSTEM_SETUP.md#simulation). The box setup starts from an unsolvated `complex_raw.gro`. An already solvated or equilibrated system enters at its reviewed stage, using its own matching topology, coordinates, groups and checkpoint. | | Reviewed NPT or pilot endpoint | Use the same-stage GRO and CPT in [production preparation](SIMULATION.md#production). Verify the compiled TPR and topology, then follow the [server handoff](SIMULATION.md#server-handoff). | If preprocessing fails, read the first `grompp` error. Check charge, atom order, topology includes and restraint references in [parameterization and topology troubleshooting](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#topology-errors). Review [complex systems](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#complex-systems) before using this soluble-system example for a multichain pocket, nonstandard residue, metal, cofactor, or membrane assembly. ## Analyze an existing trajectory or make figures Prepare a fresh analysis directory with a full-system XTC and its matching TPR, plus an index for that atom order. Step 11 uses the local names `md.xtc`, `md.tpr` and `index.ndx`. Use the existing GROMACS environment for calculations. If installing just for this route, install GROMACS 2026.3 from [the CPU setup](ENVIRONMENT.md#setup). Review the [input and index checks](ANALYSIS.md#analysis) before imaging or calculating ligand RMSD. A stripped trajectory needs a reference and groups for that exact subset and order. For precomputed XVG or a matching structure file, go directly to the [Python plotting](ANALYSIS.md#python-figures) or [PyMOL structure rendering](ANALYSIS.md#pymol-image-export). The [published 1IEP v0.1.0 archive](https://github.com/LuciferBioLab/docking-gromacs-tutorial/releases/tag/v0.1.0) is suitable for plotting the included ligand RMSD and viewing `analysis/complex.pdb`. It contains the smoke XTC but omits the TPR and index required for the complete trajectory analysis. Keep the reported time and distance units when plotting archived XVG values. ## Run the public 1IEP MD teaching example Use the complete `docking-gromacs` environment from above and return to the repository root first. The smoke and 1 ns commands create new directories. Choose a new name for each run.
blocks.zh: | 已有输入 | 接到哪一步 | | --- | --- | | 已核验的位姿 SDF 和蛋白 PDB | 选择 AMBER 或 CHARMM [参数化路线](SYSTEM_SETUP.zh-CN.md#topology)。记录配体净电荷（e），核对 Å 到 nm 的转换。[组装](SYSTEM_SETUP.zh-CN.md#complex-assembly)后得到 `complex_raw.gro`、`topol.top` 及其 include 文件。 | | 已配对的组装结构和 topology（拓扑） | 从[体系准备与平衡](SIMULATION.zh-CN.md#equilibration)的对应步骤进入，并使用[各阶段 MDP](SYSTEM_SETUP.zh-CN.md#simulation)。加盒示例从未溶剂化的 `complex_raw.gro` 开始。已有溶剂化或平衡结构时，从已验收的阶段进入，使用与该阶段匹配的拓扑、坐标、索引组和检查点。 | | 已验收的 NPT 或 Pilot 终态 | 用同一阶段的 GRO 和 CPT [生成生产 TPR](SIMULATION.zh-CN.md#production)。核对 TPR 与拓扑，再按[服务器交接](SIMULATION.zh-CN.md#server-handoff)执行。 | 预处理失败时先读第一条 `grompp` 报错，再按[参数化与拓扑排错](TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md#topology-errors)核对电荷、原子顺序、拓扑 include 文件与位置限制参考。若体系有多链口袋、非标准残基、金属、辅因子或膜组装，先查[复杂体系](TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md#complex-systems)再选择方案。 ## 用已有轨迹分析或出图 在新分析目录中放入全体系 XTC、与之配对的 TPR 和对应同一原子顺序的索引。步骤 11 使用本地文件名 `md.xtc`、`md.tpr` 和 `index.ndx`。轨迹计算使用已有的 GROMACS 环境。只需安装分析工具时，可按 [CPU 环境设置](ENVIRONMENT.zh-CN.md#setup)安装 GROMACS 2026.3。处理周期边界或计算配体 RMSD 前，先做[输入和索引核查](ANALYSIS.zh-CN.md#analysis)。抽取过原子的轨迹需搭配相同原子子集和顺序的参考结构与索引。已有 XVG 或配对的结构文件时，可直接使用 [Python 绘图](ANALYSIS.zh-CN.md#python-figures)或 [PyMOL 结构渲染](ANALYSIS.zh-CN.md#pymol-image-export)。 [已发布的 1IEP v0.1.0 示例包](https://github.com/LuciferBioLab/docking-gromacs-tutorial/releases/tag/v0.1.0)可用于绘制包内的配体 RMSD 并查看 `analysis/complex.pdb`。其中含短测 XTC，且完整轨迹分析所需的 TPR 和索引须另外准备。用归档 XVG 出图时保留其时间与距离单位。 ## 运行公开 1IEP MD 教学示例 使用前面创建的完整 `docking-gromacs` 环境，并先回到仓库根目录。短测和 1 ns 示例都会新建目录，每次运行请选择新的目录名。

blocks.shared:
```bash
bash scripts/run_example.sh --dry-run smoke runs/1iep-smoke
make smoke RUN=runs/1iep-smoke THREADS=4
make quickstart RUN=runs/1iep-1ns THREADS=4
```

blocks.en: Run the smoke or the 1 ns profile according to your goal. The smoke profile performs 2 ps of production after brief numerical preflight, and the 1 ns profile uses 50 ps NVT and 100 ps NPT. Ten minutes is a hands-on onboarding target after installation. Actual wall time includes charge assignment, equilibration, and MD and may be substantially longer. These stages demonstrate handoff and data integrity. A research run requires a separate equilibration and sampling decision. | Goal | Required | Can omit for that goal | | --- | --- | --- | | Docking only | Vina, Meeko, RDKit, Open Babel, prepared receptor and ligand, box | GROMACS, AmberTools, production, plotting | | MD with a reviewed docked pose | Original ligand chemistry, verified coordinates, chosen force field, GROMACS | Redocking only if provenance and atom mapping are already validated | | Analyze or make figures | Matching trajectory, topology or reference structure, and index; choose the analysis tool | Docking, parameterization and rerunning MD if inputs are consistent | | Stage | Inputs → expected output | Planning time and disk | | --- | --- | --- | | 01 | `environment.yml` → tool commands available | Initial solve/download can take minutes; allow about 5 GiB including cache | | 02 | Public PDB, SDF and checksum → `OK` | Seconds, under 2 MiB | | 03 | Ordered PDB + SDF → receptor and ligand PDBQT | Seconds in 1IEP, under 2 MiB | | 04 | PDBQT + box → `docked.pdbqt` with Vina scores | Seconds to minutes; under 2 MiB for this small run | | 05 | PDBQT + source graph → `lig_pose.sdf`, `redocking.csv` | Seconds; under 1 MiB | | 06 | Validated MOL2 + net charge → ACPYPE GRO/ITP | Minutes for AM1-BCC; allow several MiB for temporary files | | 07 | Protein GRO + ligand GRO/ITP → `complex.gro`, `topol.top` | Seconds to minutes, a few MiB | | 08 | Profile + seed → stage MDP files | Seconds; small text files | | 09 | Solute + matching parameter files → `npt.gro`, `npt.cpt` | Depends on solvation and equilibration length; reserve tens of MiB for the smoke | | 10 | NPT endpoint → `md.tpr`, `md.xtc`, `md.cpt` | Measure ns/day on the actual node; XTC size scales with output frames | | 11 | Matched full-system XTC/TPR → `ligand-rmsd.xvg`, `complex.pdb` | Seconds for smoke; reimaged XTCs can require two extra copies | | 12 | Validated outputs → `provenance/outputs.sha256` | Seconds for smoke; grows with files hashed | If any stage fails, read `logs/.log` for the first error and use the relevant `scripts/check_XX.sh`. To inspect a manual step from another shell, re-enter the intended replicate directory and re-export its variables. [File map and checklist](WORKFLOW.md#toolchain) · [Triage order](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#triage) ## Version and platform matrix Recorded on **2026-11-28**. The reproducibility target is the same repository snapshot as these commands. Record `git rev-parse HEAD` and the environment lock hash for every published run. | Component | Version or route | Verification | | --- | --- | --- | | Vina | 1.2.7 | 1IEP redock | | Meeko | 0.8.0 | Receptor and ligand preparation, mapped export | | RDKit | 2026.03.1 | SDF identity and mapping checks | | Open Babel | 3.2.1 | Format round trip and fixed-frame RMSD | | AmberTools / ACPYPE | 26.0 / 2023.10.27 | 1IEP AM1-BCC and GAFF2 files | | GROMACS | 2026.3, conda-forge thread-MPI build | Validation status below | | Uni-Dock | 1.2.0, CUDA route | Versioned manual; no CUDA device in this validation | | AutoDock-Vina-GPU | 2.1, OpenCL route | [Upstream source reviewed](DOCKING.md#vina-gpu-opencl); GPU run pending | | CGenFF | 5.0 cutoff example | Upstream parameter and conversion documentation | The environment YAML specifies the direct dependencies. The [Linux x86-64 lock](../environment/linux-64.explicit.txt) pins the exact package builds.
blocks.zh: 按目标选择 smoke 或 1 ns 档。smoke 档在简短数值预检后做 2 ps 生产段。1 ns 档采用 50 ps NVT 和 100 ps NPT。十分钟是安装后的上手操作目标；实耗时还包括算电荷、平衡和 MD，可能明显更长。教学档验证的是流程交接及数据完整性，研究生产段应独立判断平衡和采样要求。 | 目标 | 必需工具或文件 | 可略过 | | --- | --- | --- | | 只做对接 | Vina、Meeko、RDKit、Open Babel、已制备 receptor（受体）与配体、搜索盒 | GROMACS、AmberTools、生产段、绘图 | | 用已核验的 docking pose（对接位姿）跑 MD | 原始化学图、核验后的坐标、选定的 force field（力场）、GROMACS | 来源与 atom mapping（原子映射）均已核验时，可略去重对接 | | 只分析或出图 | 相匹配的轨迹、topology（拓扑）或参考文件、索引以及所选分析工具 | 文件一致时可略过对接、参数化和重跑 MD | | 阶段 | 输入 → 预期输出 | 规划耗时和磁盘 | | --- | --- | --- | | 01 | `environment.yml` → 工具命令可调用 | 首次解算和下载可达数分钟；含缓存预留约 5 GiB | | 02 | 公开 PDB、SDF 与哈希 → `OK` | 数秒，小于 2 MiB | | 03 | 排序后的 PDB、SDF → receptor（受体）和配体 PDBQT | 1IEP 数秒，小于 2 MiB | | 04 | PDBQT 与搜索盒 → 含分数的 `docked.pdbqt` | 数秒到数分钟，本例小于 2 MiB | | 05 | PDBQT 与原始化学图 → `lig_pose.sdf`、`redocking.csv` | 数秒，小于 1 MiB | | 06 | 已核验 MOL2 与净电荷 → ACPYPE GRO/ITP | AM1-BCC 可达数分钟；临时文件留数 MiB | | 07 | 蛋白 GRO 与配体 GRO/ITP → `complex.gro`、`topol.top` | 数秒至数分钟，数 MiB | | 08 | 档位与种子 → 各阶段 MDP | 数秒，小型文本 | | 09 | 溶质与匹配的参数文件 → `npt.gro`、`npt.cpt` | 取决于溶剂化与平衡时长；smoke 留几十 MiB | | 10 | NPT 末态 → `md.tpr`、`md.xtc`、`md.cpt` | 对目标节点实测 ns/day；XTC 占用随帧数增长 | | 11 | 匹配的全体系 XTC/TPR → `ligand-rmsd.xvg`、`complex.pdb` | smoke 数秒；周期边界处理可能多出两份 XTC | | 12 | 通过验收的输出 → `provenance/outputs.sha256` | smoke 数秒，取决于校验文件大小 | 某一阶段失败时，先查 `logs/.log` 最早的错误，再跑对应的 `scripts/check_XX.sh`。另开终端后先进入正确的重复目录，并重设当节用到的变量。[文件地图与核查表](WORKFLOW.zh-CN.md#toolchain) · [排错顺序](TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md#triage) ## 版本与平台矩阵 验证记录日期为 **2026-11-28**。复现目标是与本文命令同一份仓库快照。发表时另记 `git rev-parse HEAD` 与环境锁的哈希。 | 组件 | 版本或路线 | 验证 | | --- | --- | --- | | Vina | 1.2.7 | 1IEP 重对接 | | Meeko | 0.8.0 | receptor（受体）与配体制备，按映射导出 | | RDKit | 2026.03.1 | SDF 化学身份与映射检查 | | Open Babel | 3.2.1 | 格式往返及固定坐标系 RMSD | | AmberTools / ACPYPE | 26.0 / 2023.10.27 | 1IEP AM1-BCC 与 GAFF2 文件 | | GROMACS | 2026.3，conda-forge thread-MPI 构建 | 验证状态见下方 | | Uni-Dock | 1.2.0，CUDA 路线 | 对照版本手册；此次验证环境无 CUDA | | AutoDock-Vina-GPU | 2.1，OpenCL 路线 | [已核对上游源码](DOCKING.zh-CN.md#vina-gpu-opencl)，待 GPU 实跑 | | CGenFF | 5.0 普通截断示例 | 对照上游参数与移植文档 | `environment.yml` 声明直接依赖。[Linux x86-64 锁文件](../environment/linux-64.explicit.txt) 固定实际软件包构建。

blocks.shared:
```bash
(cd environment && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS)
conda create -n docking-gromacs-locked --file environment/linux-64.explicit.txt
```

blocks.en: | Platform | Starting budget for orientation | Limits | | --- | --- | --- | | CPU, Linux/WSL2 | 2–4 CPU cores, 8 GiB RAM, 8 GiB free SSD | Teaching example; measure performance for your system | | CUDA workstation | 4+ CPU cores, 16 GiB RAM, 8 GiB VRAM as a planning starting point | Actual Uni-Dock batch size and MD atom count determine memory demand | | Cluster | Start with the site-supported binary and local scratch | Match ranks and OpenMP threads to scheduler allocation | ## Validation boundary The full 01–12 CPU smoke passed using four CPU threads. Production was 2 ps. The run produced the prepared topology, readable TPR, CPT, XTC, and a protein-aligned ligand RMSD series. The short run reports **14.36 ns/day** for production, which is an observed smoke rate that includes short-run overhead. Charge assignment and preparation time are additional. See [verification outputs](../examples/expected/README.md). | Workflow | Evidence and status | | --- | --- | | 1 ns CPU quickstart | Preparation and equilibration completed. The last production log record was 96.6 ps. The run ended before the target and left no production checkpoint. | | Uni-Dock, Vina-GPU and GROMACS CUDA | Setup documented. No GPU throughput measurements. | | CHARMM and the paired AMBER/CHARMM comparison | Parameterization and comparison design documented. [Validation and sampling](RESEARCH.md#sampling) ## 100 ns storage and time budget At 2 fs (`dt = 0.002` ps), 100 ns takes 50,000,000 integration steps. For a fresh run starting at step 0, with a positive output stride `S` in steps, the complete XTC contains `ceil(nsteps / S) + 1` frames. The first and last coordinates are written, so the last interval can be shorter when the end step falls between regular writes. Use actual trajectory timestamps for frame-based analysis. [GROMACS 2026.3 coordinate-output settings](https://manual.gromacs.org/2026.3/user-guide/mdp-options.html#mdp-nstxout-compressed) | Output interval | `nstxout-compressed` | Complete frames | Estimated XTC per replica | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | | 10 ps | 5,000 | 10,001 | 1.90 GiB | | 30 ps | 15,000 | 3,335 | 0.63 GiB | The estimates use 2,245,348 bytes across 11 full-system frames from the completed public CPU smoke (55,134 atoms, `compressed-x-precision = 1000`). For your own system, multiply the measured bytes per frame by the expected frame count and number of replicas. Reserve space separately for reimaged copies, logs, checkpoints, energy files and any uncompressed trajectory. Budget time as production ns divided by the measured ns/day. At 13.82 ns/day from the short public CPU benchmark, 100 ns would take about 7.24 days per replica, plus setup and equilibration.
